question: List the names of male superheroes from Marvel Comics who have the highest strength attribute value among all heroes and whose height is greater than 80% of the average superhero height.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Male'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T4."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      INNER JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2."XCL_010" = a2."XCL_003"
      WHERE a2."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  )
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG(s2."XCL_028") FROM superhero AS s2)
